source: Local build inventory of ~/invoicefinance-site (163 pages, all gate-passing). Owned greenfield invoice-finance authority site (the held 2nd IF site, 22/25). Domain/brand TBD; built domain-agnostic.

clusters: Lead on the embedded-finance wedge (+196% YoY, wide-open SERP, AIO firing); capture classic IF (factoring/discounting, declining ~30% YoY) underneath.
Target Bing + AI citation first, Google as upside. Every IF SERP audited was wide-open; Bing IF SERPs broken/uncontested.
Differentiator vs MarketInvoice: same niches, its own version (broker/practitioner angle, never a reskin).
authority_pillars: Lender panel + best-for shortlists (broker placement angle)
First-party UK Invoice Finance Market Index (data product, Dataset schema)
Agent-data layer: REST API + MCP server + OpenAPI
Full E-E-A-T stack (schema @graph, named author TBD, FCA/CH on entity decision)
